When you do, your opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your character level + your Wisdom modifier). If the target fails the saving throw, it takes either 1d4 Charisma damage or 1d4 Constitution damage, or it becomes fatigued (your choice). Ability score damage dealt with this ability cannot equal or exceed the victim’s actual ability score total.

name: Wolf Style
prerequisites: Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, Knowledge (nature) 3 ranks.
benefit: Decrease a foe's speed when you deal at least 10 points of damage with an attack of opportunity
text:
While in this style, you hamper foes that turn their backs on you.
Prerequisites: Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, Knowledge (nature) 3 ranks.
Benefit: While using this style, whenever you deal at least 10 points of damage to a foe with an attack of opportunity, that foe’s base speed decreases by 5 feet until the end of its next turn. For every 10 points of damage your attack deals beyond 10, the foe’s base speed decreases by an additional 5 feet. If the penalty meets or exceeds the total base speed of the foe, you can attempt to trip the foe as a free action after the attack of opportunity is resolved.

name: Wolf Trip
prerequisites: Wis 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Wolf Style, Knowledge (nature) 6 ranks.
benefit: Gain a +2 bonus on trip attempts you make as part of an attack of opportunity
text:
You have studied the manner in which wolves bring down their prey.
Prerequisites: Wis 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Wolf Style, Knowledge (nature) 6 ranks.
Benefit: While using Wolf Style, you gain a +2 bonus when you attempt a trip combat maneuver as part of an attack of opportunity. Whenever you successfully trip a creature, as a free action you can choose an available space that is both adjacent to you and the creature’s original space for the tripped creature to land prone in.

name: Wood Crafter
prerequisites: Craft (armor) 3 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 3 ranks.
benefit: Gain +4 bonus on Craft (armor) checks when working with wood, can sometimes craft items at a discount
text:
Eschewing the use of metals in your craft, you excel at crafting armor from wood.
Prerequisites: Craft (armor) 3 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 3 ranks.
Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on Craft (armor) checks to create armor and shields from wood or special materials containing wood (such as darkwood). If you succeed at the check by 5 or more, you decrease the cost to make the item by 10%.

name: Woodland Wraith
prerequisites: Dex 15, Dodge, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: Gain concealment when withdrawing or taking multiple actions and ending movement in naturally occurring difficult terrain
text:
You put the terrain between yourself and your opponents to avoid attacks.
Prerequisites: Dex 15, Dodge, base attack bonus +6.
Benefit: If you take two actions to move or a withdrawal action in a turn while starting or ending your movement in either naturally occurring difficult terrain (bushes, brambles, etc.) or a space with a natural object providing at least partial cover (a tree, rock, etc.), you gain concealment until you attack, until you move out of that space, or until the end of your next turn, whichever occurs first.

name: Word of Healing
prerequisites: Lay on hands class feature.
benefit: Use lay on hands from a distance
text:
Using the same divine energy as your lay on hands ability, you can heal others at a distance.
Prerequisites: Lay on hands class feature.
Benefit: You may use your lay on hands to heal another creature at a range of 30 feet as a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. You must be able to speak and have a free hand to use this ability. The target heals half the amount they would have healed if you had touched them, but gains the benefits of your mercies as normal.

name: Worldwound Walker
prerequisites: 5 or more Hit Dice, good alignment.
benefit: Protect yourself from effects which target good creatures
text:
Your purity always remains a blessing, even when you’re
 surrounded by creatures that despise it.
Prerequisites: 5 or more Hit Dice, good alignment.
Benefit: You can alter the essence of your being to lessen
 the effects of spells designed to harm good creatures.
 When affected by spells and effects that behave differently
 according to alignment (such as unholy word or protection
 from good), you can choose whether you are considered
 good or neutral. This ability does not actually change your
 alignment or fool divinations, nor does it permit you to
 overcome alignment requirements for the use of magic
 items, class abilities, and so on.

name: Worst Case Jinx
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Halfling Jinx trait.
benefit: Hinder the effects of beneficial spells with your jinx
text:
Your jinxes hinder beneficial spells.
Prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Halfling Jinx trait.
Benefit: Beneficial variable effects on a jinxed target (such as aid, cure spells, false life, the variable ability damage cured by lesser restoration, and so on) always result in the minimum possible amount for the effect. For example, a 5th-level cleric casting cure serious wounds on the target only heals 8 hit points (the minimum for 3d8+5).

name: Wounded Paw Gambit
prerequisites: Broken Wing Gambit, Bluff 5 ranks.
benefit: When you use Broken Wing Gambit, nearby allies can attempt a ranged attack against the attacker
text:
Your enemy sees you as an easy mark, but doesn’t notice your allies poised to shoot.
Prerequisites: Broken Wing Gambit, Bluff 5 ranks.
Benefit: Whenever you use Broken Wing Gambit and an opponent attacks you as a result, each ally who has this feat and is within 30 feet of that opponent can attempt a ranged attack against it as an immediate action. The ally’s ranged weapon must be in hand, loaded, and ready to be fired or thrown in order to make this attack possible.

name: Wrest Charge
prerequisites: Disable Device 5 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks
benefit: Jury-rig a depleted battery to hold 1 charge
text:
You can extract a charge from otherwise depleted technology.
Prerequisites: Disable Device 5 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks
Benefit: With a successful DC 20 Disable Device check, you can jury-rig a depleted (but not destroyed) battery so it provides 1 more charge. Using this charge or failing your check by 5 or more permanently depletes the battery.

name: Wretched Curator
prerequisites: You must have purchased a scroll or spellbook containing a spell with the evil descriptor in a place where such dealings are illegal, or must have the Secret Society Inductee or Diabolical Upbringing background.
benefit: Purchase evil items cheaper, bonus to checks to understand evil items
text:
Some fools fear the written word, but you that understand knowledge—all knowledge—is a valuable tool, and restricting it out of superstition is abominable in your eyes.
Prerequisites: You must have purchased a scroll or spellbook containing a spell with the evil descriptor in a place where such dealings are illegal, or must have the Secret Society Inductee or Diabolical Upbringing background.
Benefit: You can always purchase potions and scrolls of spells with the evil descriptor at a 10% discount, even if they are not normally available in a settlement because of its size or the local laws. You gain a +4 bonus on Knowledge (arcana), Spellcraft, and Use Magic Device checks related to spells with the evil descriptor or evil written works.

name: Wrist Grab
prerequisites: Dex 13, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Improved Disarm, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: Immediate disarm when your opponent misses by 5 or more
text:
When an enemy overextends to attack you, you quickly catch its arm and knock its weapon loose.
Prerequisites: Dex 13, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Improved Disarm, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +6.
Benefit: When an opponent’s attack misses you by 5 or more, you can attempt a disarm combat maneuver check against that foe as an immediate action.

name: Wyvaran Spellcasting
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 6 ranks, wyvaran.
benefit: Gain a draconic spell-like abilitiy.
text:
Your unique physiology makes you particularly adept at wielding draconic magic.
Prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 6 ranks, wyvaran.
Benefit: Select one spell you can cast that you gained through your draconic bloodline, the Scalykind domain (Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide 216), or the Dragon subdomain (Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods 224). It must be at least 1 spell level lower than the highest-level spell you can cast. You can cast this spell as a spell-like ability twice per day.

name: Wyvern Fury Style
prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Acrobatics 3 ranks, brawler’s flurryACG class feature or flurry of blows class feature.
benefit: Use daggers and whips with your flurry.
text:
You can combine sweeping attacks with a whip and quick stabs with a blade, imitating a wyvern’s powerful bite and tail tipped with a stinger.
Prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Acrobatics 3 ranks, brawler’s flurryACG class feature or flurry of blows class feature.
Benefit: While using this style, you can make attacks with a dagger, punching dagger, scorpion whipUC, spiked gauntlet, or whip when using a flurry of blows or brawler’s flurry. Only one of these attacks can be made with a whip or scorpion whip.

name: Wyvern Sting
prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Wyvern Fury Style, Acrobatics 6 ranks, brawler’s flurryACG class feature or flurry of blows class feature.
benefit: When using Wyvern Style, you can use a whip to force an enemy to focus on you.
text:
You can use your whip like a wyvern’s sting, forcing foes to give it their undivided attention.
Prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Wyvern Fury Style, Acrobatics 6 ranks, brawler’s flurryACG class feature or flurry of blows class feature.
Benefit: While using Wyvern Fury Style, if you successfully attack a foe with a whip or scorpion whipUC, as a swift action you can choose one ally. Until the beginning of your next turn, that ally can leave spaces threatened by that foe without provoking an attack of opportunity from the foe.

name: Wyvern Wing
prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Wyvern Fury Style, Wyvern Sting, Acrobatics 10 ranks, brawler’s flurryACG class feature or flurry of blows class feature.
benefit: Make an additional 5ft step between attacks when using Wyvern Style
text:
Like a wyvern on the wing, you command a fluid style that enables you to make attacks while moving.
Prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (whip), Wyvern Fury Style, Wyvern Sting, Acrobatics 10 ranks, brawler’s flurryACG class feature or flurry of blows class feature.
Benefit: While using the Wyvern Style feat, if you use flurry of blows or brawler’s flurry and take a 5-foot step, you can take an additional 5-foot step. You can take this extra 5-foot step only between two attacks in your flurry, but you can take both your 5-foot steps consecutively without making an attack between them.

name: Xenoglossy
prerequisites: Int 13, Linguistics 3 ranks.
benefit: Use Linguistics to communicate with creatures with which you don’t share a language
text:
People everywhere share a common tongue; they just don’t always remember it.
Prerequisites: Int 13, Linguistics 3 ranks.
Benefit: With a successful DC 25 Linguistics check, you can speak with a single individual with whom you share no common languages. You cannot take 10 on this check, nor can anyone aid you. You believe you are speaking your native language, and the listener believes you are speaking its native language; however, to everyone else able to hear you, you sound like you are speaking gibberish. Creatures that have truespeech or that are under the effects of tongues can understand Xenoglossy, and other creatures who succeed at a DC 25 Linguistics check can pick up the gist of what you are saying. Xenoglossy lasts for the length of the conversation or for 1 minute per level, whichever is shorter. You can use Xenoglossy again to continue a longer conversation, and you gain a +2 on Linguistics checks to use Xenoglossy to communicate with someone with whom you previously communicated using this feat. If you fail a Xenoglossy check, you can’t use the Xenoglossy feat to attempt further communication with that creature until you gain additional ranks in Linguistics.

name: Yai-Mimic Spell
prerequisites: Int 15, Still Spell.
benefit: Modify a ray spell to fire from your forehead, granting you brief regeneration
text:
You have studied the magical nature of giant oni and can use your spells to imitate their esoteric features.
Prerequisites: Int 15, Still Spell.
Benefit: You can modify a ray spell to issue from the center of your forehead, where the third eye would be on a yai. This spell doesn’t require somatic components. When the spell is cast, you gain regeneration 1 for a number of rounds equal to the original level of the spell. This regeneration can’t regrow lost body parts or reattach severed limbs. Fire or acid damage suppresses this regeneration for 1 round, which counts against the total duration of the regeneration effect. A yai-mimic spell uses up a spell slot 3 levels higher than the spell’s actual level.

name: Zealous Mind
prerequisites: Iron Will, Unimpeachable HonorUI, lawful alignment.
benefit: Gain additional bonuses against enchantments
text:
You are so steadfast in the principles of your alignment, even magic has difficult swaying you.
Prerequisites: Iron Will, Unimpeachable HonorUI, lawful alignment.
Benefit: Whenever you are under the effect of a charm or compulsion effect cast by or coming from a source with a chaotic alignment or an alignment on the good and evil axis opposite of your alignment (evil if you are good, and good if you are evil) you gain a +2 on any saving throw or opposed Charisma check to break free from the effect. This bonus stacks with itself and with the bonus granted by Unimpeachable Honor.

name: Artistry
prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dueling sword), Weapon Finesse, base attack bonus +2
benefit: Choose one of the following combat maneuvers: disarm, reposition, steal, sunder, or trip. You gain a +2 bonus when performing the selected maneuver while wielding a dueling sword. This bonus does not stack with the bonus provided by a combat maneuver feat with -improved- in its name (such as Improved Trip)

name: Battering Repair
prerequisites: Craft (alchemy) 3 ranks; grit class feature or Amateur Gunslinger; pistol-whip gunslinger deed; quick clear gunslinger deed.
benefit: Sometimes smacking your firearm against a solid surface is all that’s needed to unjam it. Sometimes that solid surface is a creature.

name: Become the Swarm
prerequisites: Vampire
benefit: You can change into a bat swarm, centipede swarm, rat swarm, or spider swarm.

name: Black Marketeer
benefit: Use black market connections to gather illegal/illicit items.

name: Bleeding Attack
prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike
benefit: +1d4 bleed damage with unarmed strikes

name: Blood Disciple
prerequisites: Associate (a temple).
benefit: Combine your blood and unholy water to create potions.

name: Blood of the Deep
prerequisites: Vampire
benefit: You are not harmed by running water and you gain a swim speed equal to normal movement rate.

name: Blood Vengance
prerequisites: Half-orc or orc, nonlawful
benefit: Enter a limited rage when one of your allies is knocked out

name: Conceal Scent
benefit: Creatures cannot track you by scent.

name: Conscript
prerequisites: Serf in service to a lord
benefit: When wielding a farm implement (such as hand axe, pick, pitchfork, or scythe) as a weapon, get +1 bonus on damage rolls. When fighting alongside other conscripts get +1 bonus on init checks.

name: Corsair
benefit: +2 initiative while on ships, +1 damage with light or one-handed weapons on ships.

name: Creature of Darkness
prerequisites: Darkvision 60 ft., undead
benefit: Your darkvision increases to 120 ft. & you can also see perfectly in any darkness.

name: Cushioning Shield (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: When you fall 10 or more feet, you can direct half of the falling damage you would take to your shield.

name: Dark Flight
prerequisites: Vampire
benefit: You gain a fly speed 40 ft. (good).

name: Defended Movement (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to your AC against attacks of opportunity.

name: Deft Shootist Deed
prerequisites: Amateur Gunslinger feat or grit class feature, Dodge, Mobility.
benefit: Do not provoke attacks of opportunity while shooting or reloading firearms as long as you have 1 grit point

name: Divine Assault
prerequisites: Bluff 1 rank, Knowledge (religion) 1 rank, Pure Legion Recruit trait
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against divine spells and effects and abilities from outsiders. If you must attempt a saving throw against a divine spell, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against the creature that cast the spell.

name: Dog Killer-Horse Hunter
prerequisites: Goblin, Handle Animal 1 rank
benefit: You gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls as well as rolls to confirm critical hits against dogs and horses (and similar creatures).

name: Draconic Discipline
prerequisites: Wis 17, base Will +10, any lawful alignment, dragon type
benefit: Get a second retry on necromancy or mind-affecting enchantment spells.

name: Dueling Mastery
prerequisites: Weapon Proficiency (dueling sword), Quick Draw, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (dueling sword)
benefit: Gain combat benefits when using dueling swords

name: Duelist
prerequisites: Dex 13, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (falcata), Weapon Focus (falcata), proficient with a buckler
benefit: When fighting with the falcata and buckler, your shield bonus to AC increases by +1 and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Acrobatics checks.

name: Eldritch Eye
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 4 ranks, ability to cast arcane spells
benefit: Gain a third eye with magic powers.

name: Exorcist
prerequisites: Iron Will, can’t have a patron deity
benefit: You can stagger incorporeal and possessed creatures through sheer force of will.

name: Experienced Vagabond
prerequisites: Bluff 1 rank, Knowledge (local) 1 rank, member of an underclass
benefit: Bonus when dealing with criminals and unsavory characters.

name: Falconry Master
prerequisites: Cha 13, Animal Affinity, animal companion class feature
benefit: Bonuses when dealing with birds of prey.

name: Feint Defender (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th, Sense Motive 1 rank.
benefit: You add your shield’s bonus to AC to the DC of feint attempts against you.

name: Galley Slave
prerequisites: Profession (sailor) 1 rank, current or former galley slave
benefit: +2 bonus to Profession (sailor) checks and +2 damage bonus to first hit on ship.

name: Grave-Risen
prerequisites: Die and be brought back at least twice
benefit: Gain an ability to save yourself from death.

name: Gravity Acclimation*
prerequisites: Heavy Gravity Acclimation Str 17 or Endurance
benefit: Ignore penalties for being on heavy gravity planes and increase carrying capacity

name: Greater Ray Shield (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Dex 17, Missile Shield, Ray Shield, Spellbreaker.
benefit: When you use the Ray Shield feat, your shield is not affected by the deflected ranged touch attack.

name: Guarded Charge (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: When performing a bull rush or overrun combat maneuver as part of a charge, you don’t provoke an attack of opportunity for that maneuver. If you already have the Improved Bull Rush or Improved Overrun feats, you gain an additional +2 bonus on your combat maneuver check when attempting the respective maneuver.

name: Guild Partner
prerequisites: Associate (a guild).
benefit: Whenever you are in a settlement that is the size of small town or larger, you can purchase (but not sell) items through your contacts.

name: Hasty Rebirth
prerequisites: Lich
benefit: You rejuvenate in just one day.

name: Hell Knight Aegis
prerequisites: Heavy Armor Proficiency, BAB +5, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: Once per day as a full-round action, you can give your armor the broken condition.

name: Hell Knight Obedience
prerequisites: Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: Upon taking this feat, you gain proficiency in all of your order’s favored weapons. Additionally, by meditating and inflicting strenuous reckonings upon yourself, you unlock the power behind your order’s doctrine.

name: Hell Knight Obsession
prerequisites: Hell Knight Obedience, Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: During your hour-long reckoning, if you choose to deal lethal damage to yourself, you reach a state of fantastic focus.

name: Hide-Out
prerequisites: Associate (an assassins guild).
benefit: Anyone attempting to locate or scry upon you finds it more difficult.

name: Hindrance Dismissal
benefit: You can dismiss any pit spell (such as create pit, hungry pit, spiked pit, and similar spells with ‘pit’ in their names) or wall spell (such as wall of fire, wall of ice, and similar spells with ‘wall’ in their names) you cast. The spells must have a duration of at least 1 round. This ability follows the normal rules for dismissing spells, allowing you to dismiss conjured pits and walls as a standard action.

name: Imperial Knight
prerequisites: BAB +6, heavy armor proficiency, proficient in a martial weapon
benefit: Gain a cohort (see Leadership); cohort is human or halfling commoner, expert, or warrior with Squire feat. When within 10 ft. of squire, get +2 bonus on init checks and +1 dodge bonus to AC.

name: Imperial Squire
prerequisites: BAB +1, proficient in a martial weapon
benefit: When within 50 ft. of a mounted ally with the Mounted Combat feat, gain +2 bonus on init. If ally is injured, gain +1 dodge bonus on AC as long as you are within 10 ft. of him.

name: Judgment Surge1
prerequisites: Judgment class feature1
benefit: Gain improved versions of your judgments.

name: Keif Euphoria
prerequisites: Keif Addict or Keif Magic
benefit: Gain a bonus to your Willpower while under the effects of drug.

name: Keif Healing
prerequisites: Keif Addict or Keif Magic
benefit: Heal by using a drug.

name: Keif Magic
prerequisites: Able to cast 2nd-level spells, keif user, and Spell Focus (enchantment) or Spell Focus (necromancy)
benefit: You can easily recognize all forms of keif, including tainted or false forms, and gain a +5 competence bonus to Appraise checks made to determine the value of keif or realize that a substance is not the real thing. You gain a +1 bonus on Fortitude saving throws and a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison. This feat counts as the Endurance feat for the purpose of qualifying for the Diehard feat.

name: Keif Rejuvenation
prerequisites: Keif Addict
benefit: Stave off the effects of death while using a particular kind of drug.

name: Knights Candidate
prerequisites: Character level 5th, convince four different knights and either a member of the council or a town mayor to write letters of commendation on your behalf.
benefit: Gain a specific bonus based on the branch of Eagle Knights you join.

name: Leaping Shot Deed
prerequisites: Dex 13, Amateur Gunslinger feat or grit class feature, Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +4.
benefit: May move your speed and make firearm attacks

name: Lifting Hands of God
prerequisites: Take at least 10d6 falling damage on three different occasions and survive.
benefit: Your healing spells can be delayed to use at a later time.

name: Lingering Spirit
prerequisites: Vampire or lich
benefit: You are not destroyed or forced into gaseous form at 0 hp, you instead remain intact until you are reduced to your negative Charisma score.

name: Mage’s Tattoo
prerequisites: Spell Focus (any except divination)
benefit: Select a school of magic (other than divination) in which you have Spell Focus —you cast spells from this school at +1 CL and gain one spell-like ability usable up to three times per day.

name: Master Vampire
prerequisites: Vampire
benefit: Depending on the ability chosen, you can hear what your spawn hears, see what it sees, or communicate telepathically with it.

name: Mercenary Company Tattoos
benefit: You can Intimidate creatures able to see your tattoos, even when stress or distractions would normally prevent you from doing so.

name: Minotaur’s Charge
prerequisites: Strength 13, Improved Bull Rush, powerful charge
benefit: When you hit an opponent with a charge attack, you might also initiate a bull rush as a free action. This does not require you to move into your opponent’s square and does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If you successfully push your opponent 15 feet or more, he is also knocked prone.

name: Mortal Visage
prerequisites: Lich
benefit: You do not appear to be undead.

name: Nightstalker
prerequisites: Stealthy, darkvision, size Large or larger
benefit: Ignore size penalties and gain +2 bonus to Stealth checks when in areas of shadowy illumination.

name: Obliviating Stare
prerequisites: Allure bold stare improvement, hypnotic stare class feature, Mesmerist level 5
benefit: You can cause a target of your hypnotic stare to lose track of creatures other than yourself.

name: Penetrating Possesion
prerequisites: Magic jar as a known spell or spell-like ability, Cha 21
benefit: The first time you attempt to possess a host under the effect of protection from evil spell or any similar spell, you have a chance to dispel that spell as if you had cast dispel magic on the spell.

name: Phalanx Fighter
prerequisites: BAB +3, good alignment
benefit: You gain a sacred bonus to your AC against the attacks of evil creatures and a sacred bonus to saves against the spells and abilities of evil creatures equal to the number of adjacent allies who also have this feat.

name: Point Blank Master
prerequisites: Weapon Specialization with selected ranged weapon.
benefit: You do not provoke AoO when firing a pre-chosen ranged weapon while threatened.

name: Red Feast
prerequisites: Vampire
benefit: You deal 1d6 Con damage and gain 10 hp or 10 temporary hp from your blood drain special attack.

name: Reinforce Crafting
prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ability to cast make whole or mending
benefit: Your magical creations are hardier than most.

name: Researcher
prerequisites: Associate (an archive or library).
benefit: In a small town or larger settlement, you can research notes and gain a bonus on a Knowledge check.

name: Schooled Reserve
prerequisites: Bravery class feature
benefit: Add your Bravery bonus on saves against vampires.

name: Shadow Druid
prerequisites: Neutral evil, patron deity is an evil god
benefit: Add selected spells to your druid spell list.

name: Shield Brace (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus; base attack bonus +3 or fighter level 1st; proficiency with light shields, heavy shields, or tower shields.
benefit: You can use a two-handed weapon sized appropriately for you from the polearm or spears weapon group while also using a light, heavy, or tower shield with which you are proficient. The shield’s armor check penalty (if any) applies to attacks made with the weapon.

name: Shield Material Expertise (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: When wielding a shield made of a special material, you can use the listed ability twice per day.

name: Shield Material Mastery (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, Shield Material Expertise, base attack bonus +11 or fighter level 8th.
benefit: You can use the ability granted by Shield Material Expertise two additional times per day.

name: Shielded Mage (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +3 or fighter level 1st.
benefit: You reduce the arcane spell failure of any shield you use by 15% (to a minimum of 0%). Using a shield does not prevent you from completing somatic spell components with the hand wielding the shield.

name: Shielded Stand (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +3 or fighter level 1st.
benefit: As a swift action, you can prevent yourself or an adjacent ally from provoking an attack of opportunity when standing from prone or when picking up an object from the ground.

name: Sneaky Vagabond
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on Stealth checks when others are actively trying to find you. In crowds, this bonus increases to +4.

name: Spell-Drinker
prerequisites: Con 13; Great Fortitude, Iron Will, or Lightning Reflexes.
benefit: The magic that cannot harm you only makes you stronger.

name: Sprightly Armor (Combat, Armor Mastery)
prerequisites: Dex 13, base attack bonus +11 or fighter level 8th, armor training class feature, proficiency with light armor.
benefit: You add your armor’s enhancement bonus as a bonus on your initiative checks.

name: Star Initiate
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank, Knowledge (nature) 1 rank, Knowledge (planes) 1 rank.
benefit: Detect astrological events more easily, increase their benefits and reduce their penalties.

name: Star Scholar
prerequisites: Star Initiate, Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.
benefit: Increase the duration of effects caused by astrological events

name: Stumbling Bash (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Improved Shield Bash, Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: Creatures struck by your shield bash take a –2 penalty to their AC until the end of your next turn.

name: Subconscious Usurpation
prerequisites: Base Will save bonus +2
benefit: You have trained your subconscious to overpower your conscious mind under dire circumstances.

name: Sunlight Resistance
prerequisites: Vampire
benefit: You are able to withstand direct sunlight longer than normal.

name: Sword Oath
prerequisites: Proficient in longsword, Weapon Focus (longsword), BAB +4
benefit: You may select longsword-related feats as if you were a 4th-level fighter.

name: Toppling Bash (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Improved Shield Bash, Shield Focus, Stumbling Bash, base attack bonus +11 or fighter level 8th.
benefit: As a swift action when you hit a creature with a shield bash, you can attempt a trip combat maneuver against that creature at a –5 penalty. This does not provoke an attack of opportunity, and if your attempt fails by 10 or more, you are not knocked prone.

name: Tower Shield Specialist (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, Tower Shield Proficiency, base attack bonus +11 or fighter level 8th.
benefit: You reduce the armor check penalty for tower shields by 3, and if you have the armor training class feature, you modify the armor check penalty and maximum Dexterity bonus of tower shields as if they were armor.

name: Undead Overlord
prerequisites: Lich, 15th level
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Diplomacy checks when dealing with the undead.

name: Unhindering Shield (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th, proficiency with bucklers.
benefit: You still gain a buckler’s bonus to AC even if you use your shield hand for some other purpose. When you wield a buckler, your shield hand is considered free for the purposes of casting spells, wielding weapons, and using any other abilities that require you to have a free hand or interact with your shield, such as the swashbuckler’s precise strike deed or the Weapon Finesse feat.

name: Unnatural Armor
prerequisites: Lich
benefit: Your natural armor bonus is increased to +8.

name: Unusual Origin (Changeling)
prerequisites: Changeling
benefit: Gain +2 bonus on concentration checks and dispel checks while within 30 ft. of at least 2 other changelings or +4 if at least two of these changelings also have this feat.

name: Unusual Origin (Fetchling)
prerequisites: Fetchling
benefit: Create sensor 1/day while sleeping (as arcane eye except can view only current location on the Shadow Plane for 1 min/lvl.

name: Unusual Origin (Gillmen)
prerequisites: Gillmen
benefit: +1 CL for divination spells and spell-like abilities; cast augury 1/day while in water as a spell-like ability.

name: Urban Forager
prerequisites: Knowledge (Local) 4 ranks, Survival 4 ranks
benefit: You may use the Survival skill to forage and track in urban locations.

name: Vampiric Nobility
prerequisites: Vampire, 15th level
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Diplomacy checks when dealing with the undead, your channel resistance increases to +6, and your Dominate DC is increased by +2.

name: Variant Prayer-Scroll
prerequisites: Jiang-shi vampire
benefit: You’ve learned how to create variant vampiric prayer scrolls.

name: Versatile Jinxer
prerequisites: Iron Will, halfling jinx trait
benefit: The DC of your jinx is based on your choice of Intelligence or Wisdom instead of Charisma.

name: Well-Trained
prerequisites: Horse
benefit: Horse knows combat riding trick set, lower Handle Animal DCs

name: Whip Slinger
prerequisites: Proficient with sling
benefit: You threaten normally even when wielding a sling, double sling, or halfling sling staff.

name: Withering Touch
prerequisites: Lich
benefit: Your touch attack is more effective than normal.
